mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a variable speed pump and a single speed pump?

acceptedAnswer.text: A variable speed pump (VSP) can operate at multiple speeds, allowing precise control over water flow for different pool operations like filtration, heating, or cleaning. In contrast, a single speed pump operates at one constant, high speed. VSPs are significantly more energy-efficient, often leading to substantial savings on electricity bills, especially in areas with high energy costs like Southern California. They also run quieter and prolong equipment life due to reduced wear.
